tagline: Montanus取景器相机，1956 年发布
description: Montanus于1956年推出的取景器相机。配备Deltamon Anastigmat 45mm / f3.5 (possibly made by Enna or Staeble, who made lenses for Montanus)。

specs.镜头: Deltamon Anastigmat 45mm / f3.5 (possibly made by Enna or Staeble, who made lenses for Montanus)
specs.英文简介: The Montanus Montana was a 35mm viewfinder camera made in Germany by the Montanus company - introduced in 1956.
